name: Axelera AI Metis AIPU and Server 150p / Embedded 110m Product Brief
notes: Axelera AI official product brochure and technical specifications for Metis AIPU and Embedded 110m / Server 150p. Metis delivers 214 INT8 TOPS per AIPU with 4 D-IMC cores and RISC-V controllers; 1 GB DRAM per AIPU on 110m M.2 module (3.5-9W power consumption).
